object.description: Write a manifest's date by hand as 2026-04-215 and validate; then as 2026-04-25, and empty. Set the date through Mellon to 2026-04-215 and to 2026-04-25. Expected: 2026-04-215 gives a validation error for the metadata date and is refused when set; 2026-04-25 and an empty date give no error and are accepted.
